data.name: Rhiannon
data.gender_notes: Rhiannon is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Rhiannon is likely derived from the Welsh word 'rhi' meaning 'great' or 'majestic' and 'annon' meaning 'river'. In Welsh mythology, Rhiannon was a goddess of the earth, fertility, and horses. She was also a queen and a famous rider. The name Rhiannon carries the meaning “Queen, majestic one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Rhiannon usually hope their child will grow to embody queen, majestic one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes royalty, majesty, and power in the spiritual realm.
data.etymology: Rhiannon belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Queen, majestic one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rhiannon total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_latin.name: Rhiannon
in_latin.meaning: Celtic mythology name, possibly derived from Sanskrit and meaning 'great queen'
in_latin.long_meaning: Rhiannon nomen Celtico mythologicum, putative derivatione a Sanscritae et significatio 'regina magna'. Nomen Rhiannon in mythologiae Celticae fontibus invenitur, et potissimum in poesiensi carmine 'Mabinogion' mentionatur, ubi Rhiannon, regina gigantum, describitur. Nomen Rhiannon in cultura Christiana nonnullis fontibus invenitur, sed non est manifestum, an Rhiannon nomine Christiano sit. Potissimum in cultura moderna, Rhiannon nomen feminile elegans et classicum habetur, et in varias artes et literas includitur.

Its associations with earth goddesses, fertility, and horses add depth and sophistication, as well as an air of mystery and enchantment. For those on a spiritual journey, the name Rhiannon can serve as a reminder of the interconnectedness of the natural world and the divine feminine. It can be a powerful embodiment of the divine in daily life, offering a sense of grounding, strength, and nurturing energy. By embracing the name and its spiritual significance, individuals may find a deeper connection to the earth, their own inner wisdom, and the divine feminine goddess energy within themselves.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Rhiannon, a Welsh goddess revered in Celtic Christianity, symbolizes the divine mother who heals and protects. Her name means "great queen," embodying wisdom, nurturing love, and mystical power.
